dataset_description: SERS (Surface-Enhanced Raman Spectroscopy) spectra of 3 bacterial species (E. coli, S. aureus, S. epidermidis) collected in our laboratory on silver nanoparticle substrates. This is a PROPRIETARY EXPERIMENTAL DATASET — no external reference, no paper to search for. DO NOT perform web searches for this dataset.
train_split: data_paper_aged (spectra collected at substrate fabrication time, used for training/CV)
test_split: test_data_folder (spectra collected 6 months later on the same substrates — aged substrate causes systematic spectral drift, especially at ~1002 cm-1 phenylalanine band)
domain_shift: Substrate aging causes intra-class variance > inter-class distance. Best result so far: 51.7% on aged test (2D_GAF). Fresh heldout: ~94%. Problem is NOT solvable by normalization alone — requires domain adaptation.
